verdict.rationale: Claude documents several guardrail-adjacent primitives — tool allowlist/denylist configuration for gating what the model can invoke, strict schema validation on tool inputs/structured outputs to constrain what gets acted on, and published system cards plus Acceptable Use Policy enforcement reporting — but there is no dedicated content-moderation API endpoint or explicit 'safety settings' parameter analogous to competitors' moderation endpoints. Missing for 10: a first-party moderation/classification API, documented content-filtering configuration options, and independent/hands-on validation that these primitives reliably gate outputs before action.
